caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of geometric shapes and colored areas. The design primarily uses a palette of red, blue, and beige tones. The pattern is organized into a grid, with alternating sections of dense red shapes arranged in rows, resembling ovals and teardrop forms, and smaller repetitive marks forming blocks. Vertical and horizontal bands in deep blue intersect at regular intervals, creating a lattice-like effect, with additional smaller blue marks arranged within the bands. The background is a light beige, and the lines and patterns are clearly defined. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the text "Willoughby Ions." appears, indicating the creator. There are also handwritten markings in the upper left corner and a circled number in the bottom right on the white border.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
